# S.F.P スマイリーフットサルプロジェクト

> Adult futsal community (19+) in Nanjo Town, Okinawa, Japan.
> Practices: Wednesday & Saturday 20:00-22:00 / Sunday 19:00-21:00.
> Official rules, semi-competitive, welcoming environment.

## About

S.F.P (Smiley Futsal Project) is a futsal circle for adults in Nanjo Town (南風原町), Okinawa Prefecture, Japan.
Venue: Nansho Junior High School gymnasium (南星中学校体育館).

- Age requirement: 19 years and older
- Practice schedule: Wednesday 20:00-22:00, Saturday 20:00-22:00, Sunday 19:00-21:00
- Style: Official futsal rules, skill-focused, community-oriented

## Membership & Registration

Participation reservations via select-type.com booking system.
Open to all adults interested in futsal regardless of experience level.

## Contact & Links

- Website: https://sfp-okinawa.search-mania.net/

## Location

Nansho Junior High School Gymnasium (南星中学校体育館)
Nanjo Town (南風原町), Okinawa Prefecture, Japan
